clips.title: The story
paras: At a hut east of the Crossroads, Grub runs a roadside eatery with a cook and a baker. He is known for teaching travelers to cook with the Barrens' local vermin.

East of the Crossroads, Grub shares a hut with Duhng, his cook, and Tarban Hearthgrain, a baker. Grub makes use of the Barrens' dig rats instead of letting them go to waste. He offers travelers a recipe for simmering the rodents into stew.
